name: 3DGradient Edit
description: Build 3D shapes in the editor with gradient triggers: preview, shade and convert in one click.

point-object-id.name: Point object ID
point-object-id.description: Object ID used for every gradient point. Each point gets its own group ID automatically.

trigger-object-id.name: Gradient trigger object ID
trigger-object-id.description: Object ID of the gradient trigger (2903 in GD 2.2).

shape-size.name: Shape size
shape-size.description: Diameter of the finished shape in GD units (30 units = 1 block).

shade-steps.name: Shade levels
shade-steps.description: How many color channels the shape uses. 2 = just Color and Shadow, more = extra in-between tones.

render-parts.name: Render parts
render-parts.description: Splits every face of the shape into this many parts across and down (parts x parts), so the shading can change across a surface. 1 = one part per face. Every part becomes a gradient trigger and every corner a point object, and every point needs its own group ID (GD only has 9999), so large values may not fit. Above 128 x 128 this may lag some low end devices.

smooth-shading.name: Smooth shading
smooth-shading.description: Blend vertex normals so light fades across each face instead of every face being one flat tone.

perspective.name: Perspective
perspective.description: Draw the shape with perspective instead of a flat orthographic projection.

start-color-id.name: First color channel to try
start-color-id.description: The mod picks the first unused color channel at or above this number for the shape's colors.

button-position.name: Editor button position
button-position.description: Where the 3DGradient Edit button sits in the editor. Leave and re-enter the editor after changing. You can also press F6 in the editor (PC).
